summary: IPC Alternative Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board authorized a regular quarterly distribution for each class of common stock to holders of record as of September 30, 2026. Gross per-share amounts are $0.1042 for Class T (net $0.0878 after a $0.0164 distribution fee), $0.1042 for Class D (net $0.0994 after a $0.0048 fee), with the Class I figure truncated in the excerpt. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are present; this is an ordinary distribution declaration for a non-traded NAV REIT, so no risk-arb angle applies.
